en.headline: Fire at Prince Edward's Kam Wah Cafe injures kitchen worker
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at the 50-year-old cha chaan teng on Bute Street in about 27 minutes; a worker burned his hand fighting the flames before the cafe opened.
body: A fire broke out at Kam Wah Cafe at 45 Bute Street in Prince Edward early Saturday morning. The Fire Services Department received a report at 6:54am and deployed one jet and a breathing apparatus team, bringing the blaze under control in about 27 minutes.

Five staff members evacuated themselves. One kitchen worker suffered burns to his hand from hot oil fumes while attempting to put out the fire with an extinguisher. He was treated at the scene and did not require hospital admission, according to reports from multiple local outlets.

Sources at the scene said the cafe had not yet opened for the day and that a deep fryer in the kitchen appeared to have overheated and ignited. Kam Wah Cafe, which has operated for more than 50 years and is recommended by the Hong Kong Tourism Board, is known for its pineapple buns, milk tea, French toast and egg tarts. Firefighters investigated the cause after extinguishing the fire and placed a large smoke extractor at the entrance.

zh.headline: 太子弼街金華冰廳早上起火 廚工撲救灼傷手部
zh.dek: 消防早上約6時54分接報，約27分鐘將火救熄；五名職員疏散，一名廚工試圖滅火時手部被油煙灼傷，現場敷治後無大礙。
body: 太子弼街45號開業逾50年的金華冰廳今日（7日）早上約6時54分發生火警。消防處接報派出一條喉及一隊煙帽隊到場灌救，約27分鐘後將火救熄。
現場有五名職員自行疏散。其中一名廚房工人嘗試用滅火筒撲火期間，手部被熱油煙灼傷，經現場敷治後無需送院。多份本地報導指事發時餐廳尚未營業。
現場消息稱懷疑廚房一個炸鍋過熱「搶火」。金華冰廳是香港旅遊發展局推介的老字號茶餐廳，以菠蘿油、奶茶、西多士及蛋泒聞名。消防人員在火警撲滅後調查起因，並在門口放置大型排煙風扇。
